description: Terminal-Bench 3.0 skill-domain coverage mapping. TB3 (harbor-framework/terminal-bench) classifies tasks into seven domains and ~30 subdomains (docs/TAXONOMY.md). The tb3-* tasks are clean-room-authored to exercise TB3 skill domains whose skills are NOT already exercised by the tb2.1-competency tasks or the v1 supplementary family. Like v1-*, tb3-* tasks claim no tb2.1 competencies; unlike v1-*, they satisfy the full clean-room contract lint.
taxonomy_source: Terminal-Bench 3.0 domains/subdomains (taxonomy metadata only; no TB3 task content was used in authoring — zero-contamination policy identical to the tb2.1 clean-room)

covered_by_existing_suite.Science/Physics: ODE/RK4 numerical-simulation tasks (e.g. C-b343fa93 covering tasks)
covered_by_existing_suite.Software/*: broad tb2.1 + v1 coverage across all six subdomains
covered_by_existing_suite.ML/Evaluation: lm-eval harness and mteb evaluation competencies
covered_by_existing_suite.ML/Kernels: Triton gated-kernel / interpret-mode / explicit-reduction competencies + flint-gate
covered_by_existing_suite.Security/Forensics: pcap aggregation, file carving, incident-response competencies
